segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ חָמֵץ שֶׁנָּפְלָה עָלָיו מַפּוֹלֶת הֲרֵי הוּא כִּמְבוֹעָר. רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: כׇּל שֶׁאֵין הַכֶּלֶב יָכוֹל לְחַפֵּשׂ אַחֲרָיו.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Leavened bread upon which a rockslide has fallen is considered as though it has been eliminated,» and it is not necessary to dig it up in order to burn it. «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: Any» leavened bread that has been covered to such an extent «that a dog cannot search after it» is considered to have been eliminated.
